role: The fishing rod: right click casts or reels an EntityFishHook, damaging the rod by the reel amount; it is also enchantable (Lure/Luck of the Sea) for trades.
scope_reason: world.conf fishing = off: 'fishing rods do nothing'. ItemFishingRod.onItemRightClick begins with the WorldConf.fishing hook and returns the stack, in the oracle as well.

members.note: the WorldConf.fishing hook refuses; EntityFishHook is not ported

members.note: enchant.c special-cases ItemFishingRod as the fishing-rod enchantment type, so the librarian's enchanted-rod trades stay correct
